verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capabilities in the evidence are batch ingestion via CSV upload or API push for compliance resources and access-review user data. The API and MCP server also reach any object in the account, so users could script bulk changes themselves. No first-party bulk-action feature (multi-select edit, mass assign or update across tests, controls, vendors or tasks) is documented. Missing for 10: native bulk edit/update actions across items, bulk operations exposed through API/MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
